# Solana CLI Tool Suite Documentation

## Overview
The Solana CLI Tool Suite allows developers to deploy programs, manage accounts, and transfer SOL tokens on Devnet, Testnet, and Mainnet-Beta.

## CLI v2.0 Signer Deprecation
Beginning with Solana CLI Tool Suite v2.0.0, the standalone `--fee-payer` flag is deprecated in favor of unified transaction signer arguments `--signer <KEYPAIR>`.
Automated deployment scripts relying on standalone fee-payer flags must pass explicit signer keypairs to avoid execution failures.

## Key Features & Compatibility
- Supports Agave client validator nodes.
- Modular RPC connection pipelines for high-throughput transaction submission.
